_doc: Mission file (openspec/changes/mission-scripting; the format is docs/design/mission-files.md). Edit with tools/mission-editor or by hand.
name: Nebula sweep
objective: Sweep the nebula and engage what hides in it.

brief.text: Raiders are using the cloud to hide from the lanes' pickets. Take the fleet into the nebula and flush them out.
Sensors are short in there: close in before you trust a contact.

result.log: Nebula sweep: outnumbered in the cloud, the fleet drew off.
